# ExcelJS 4.4.0

- Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/exceljs/v/4.4.0
- Source: https://github.com/exceljs/exceljs/tree/v4.4.0
- Download: `npm pack exceljs@4.4.0`
- `exceljs-4.4.0.min.js` is the unmodified `dist/exceljs.min.js` from that package.
- MIT license: `exceljs-LICENSE.txt`, copied from the package's `LICENSE` (trailing blank line removed).
- Bundle SHA-256: `7e49da68588e250dbb8bba190d2caa8ab3787cc0284bda1d8b2f805c4df742c9`
- License SHA-256: `2ee88321435317a4dbf464f275b88fe2efe6968c381f5ce34b5de539200e5855`

The bundle is loaded by a relative dynamic import on the first export request.
No npm install, build, backend or runtime CDN is needed. The optional source map
is not vendored; it is not needed to generate workbooks. Do not auto-upgrade:
review a replacement and run all export round-trip tests before changing it.
